excerpt: Reputation (Reputation.com) helps multi-location brands manage reviews, listings, surveys and AI search visibility. Plans from $80 per location per month.
content:
Reputation, long known as Reputation.com, makes software for brands with many locations, such as car dealer networks, healthcare groups, property managers and hotel chains. Its platform pulls customer signals into one place: online reviews and AI-assisted responses, business listings and local SEO, location pages, customer surveys, social media, and insights that show sentiment and what to fix. It also offers Reputation IQ, which answers questions about customer feedback with AI, a single Rep Score metric, and tools aimed at how brands appear in AI search answers, which it calls GEO readiness.

TechCrunch reported in 2019 that Michael Fertik founded the company in 2006 as ReputationDefender, a service for individuals, and that it later sold its consumer business and pivoted to enterprises. At that point it served three of the top five car makers, more than 10,000 US car dealerships and 250 healthcare customers. Its leadership page lists Joe Burton as CEO, and its board includes investors from Bessemer Venture Partners, Kleiner Perkins, Marlin Equity, Ascension Ventures and Icon Ventures.

Funding

In August 2019 Reputation.com raised $30 million in equity led by Ascension Ventures, its second round since the pivot, according to TechCrunch.

Pricing

Reputation publishes per-location prices. Rep Core costs $80 per location per month and covers review management and business listings. Rep Core + Pulse costs $115 per location per month and adds AI insights, an AI reputation manager and basic surveys. Rep Core + Surveys costs $150 per location per month with advanced surveys and outreach campaigns. Enterprise plans for 125 or more locations are quoted, and add-ons such as social, competitive insights and managed services are priced on request.

Who it suits

It suits multi-location businesses that want reviews, listings and feedback across all sites in one dashboard. A single shop with one location may find lighter tools enough.

We have not tested Reputation. This page is based on its website, pricing and leadership pages (checked 15 October 2026) and TechCrunch.
